translations.web: His feet were like burnished brass, as if it had been refined in a furnace. His voice was like the voice of many waters.
translations.bsb: His feet were like polished bronze refined in a furnace, and His voice was like the roar of many waters.
translations.kjv: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.
translations.asv: and his feet like unto burnished brass, as if it had been refined in a furnace; and his voice as the voice of many waters.
